budgetyourtripProxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Singapore? Hotel Prices for Singapore, Singapore | Budget Your Trip
budgetyourtripProxy.evidenceText: Budget Your Trip hotel snippet reports a 1-star hotel average of $111 for one night (median $90; 71 samples), with prices in USD before taxes and from Kayak.
budgetyourtripProxy.referencePeriod: Current snippet retrieval; one-night city 1-star average
budgetyourtripProxy.reason: Exact-city 1-star numeric average and separate exact-city double-occupancy wording were both found; retained as a proxy, not direct ground truth.

directCandidates.evidenceText: Google Hotels snippet identifies Traveller@SG as a 1-star hotel and shows $41 for 1 night with taxes and fees (base $37); it does not state two adults and one room.
directCandidates.searchQuery: Singapore Singapore Google Hotels 1-star hotel two adults one room one night price taxes
directCandidates.reason: Exact class, named property, nightly numeric total, and tax treatment are present, but occupancy is not explicit.
